items.summary: Meta says it does not sell your information.
quotes: We don't sell any of your information to anyone, and we never will.

items.summary: Meta develops and improves its AI using information that can include your public posts, comments and your chats with Meta AI. The policy does not name a switch to stop this, and any objection option depends on where you live.
quotes: Develop and improve AI at Meta for Meta Products and for third parties.
Public content you or others create or share, like posts, comments or audio on Meta Products

action.label: Look for an objection or privacy option in Meta's Privacy Center
steps: Look for the AI section and any 'object' or 'opt out' option shown for your region.
If there is none, the realistic options are to limit what you post publicly or leave.

items.topic: Ads based on your activity on other sites
items.summary: Meta uses information that advertisers and partners send about your activity off Meta to personalize the ads you see, even if you are not logged in.
quotes: Receiving and using information from third parties to tailor the ads you see

action.label: Review your ad preferences
steps: Look for the settings about activity from partners (off-Meta activity) and ads shown based on it.
Turn off what you don't want.

items.summary: Meta gives businesses and advertisers measurement and audience insight reports about the people who see their ads.
quotes: Provide insights and measurement reports to businesses, advertisers and other partners

items.summary: Google uses publicly available information to help train its AI models. The policy does not offer an opt-out for public web content.
quotes: we use publicly available information to help train Google's AI models

items.summary: Depending on your settings, Google shows ads based on your interests and activity. You can turn this off.
quotes: we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests, activity

items.summary: Google says it does not personalize ads using sensitive categories such as race, religion, sexual orientation or health.
quotes: We don't show you personalized ads based on sensitive categories

items.summary: Google saves activity from your account, such as searches and visits to Google Play. You can review and delete it.
quotes: My Activity allows you to review and control data that's saved to your Google Account

action.label: Review activity controls
steps: Pause or set auto-delete for Web & App Activity, YouTube history and Location History.
Open My Activity to delete what is already saved.

items.summary: Google says it shares personal information outside Google with your consent, and otherwise only in limited cases such as legal or safety reasons.
quotes: We'll share personal information outside of Google when we have your consent
